generate_gmock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
generate_gmock_specific_class: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file with a class name to generate a mock for that class only
generate_methods_from_ast: call _GenerateMethods to produce MOCK_METHOD macro lines for virtual functions in a parsed C++ class node
generate_mocks_from_ast: call _GenerateMocks to produce full mock class definitions from a C++ AST including namespaces and templates
review_gmock_class_generator: review the gmock_class.py script to understand how it parses C++ headers and generates Google Mock classes
